P: Serve the mains at the camp Thanksgiving play.
S: Saucy beef mince on slider buns with cheddar and dill pickles

Saucy beef sloppy joe mince with capsicum and a tangy tomato glaze, piled into soft slider buns with crunchy dill pickles and melted cheddar. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 1 diced green capsicum for 10 minutes. Add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp American mustard and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Split 12 slider buns, lay half a slice of cheddar on each base, spoon on the mince and top with sliced dill pickles.
Round butter cookies with a thin dark chocolate smile
Vanilla shortbread rounds baked at 160C for 15 minutes, a thin line of dark chocolate piped across as a smile.
the camp cookout at Camp Chippewa

Thin pork sausages charred over hot coals until blistered, tucked into soft rolls with sticky onions, mild mustard and tomato relish. Slice 2 onions and cook slowly in 30g butter for 20 minutes until soft and golden, adding 1 tsp brown sugar at the end. Cook 12 thin pork sausages on a barbecue or grill pan over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning often, until blistered and cooked through. Split 12 small soft rolls and fill each with a sausage, a spoon of onions, mild mustard and tomato relish.
M: the Thanksgiving play that goes very wrong

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy and sliced, with sage and onion stuffing, cranberry sauce, buttery mash and proper pan gravy. Dissolve 60g salt and 30g sugar in 2L water and brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight. Pat dry, rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C for about 75 minutes until 70C inside, then rest 20 minutes. Bake 150g breadcrumbs mixed with 1 sautéed onion, sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock for 30 minutes. Mash 1kg potatoes with 60g butter and milk. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Grilled lobster tails with garlic lemon butter, buttered potatoes and salad
Lobster tails split and grilled with lemon and garlic butter, a crisp green salad and buttery new potatoes.
W: Roasted pumpkin pie with mixed spice, cooled before slicing
Roast pumpkin purée whisked with eggs, brown sugar, cream and spices, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes.
K: Raspberry and lemon blended into an icy slush

Fresh lemon juice and raspberries blitzed with sugar syrup and ice into a tangy pink slush, served in tall cups with a lemon wheel. Blend 200g frozen raspberries with 150ml fresh lemon juice (about 5 lemons) and 150ml sugar syrup until smooth, then strain out the seeds. Return to the blender with 500ml cold water and 4 cups of ice and blend until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 tall cups with a lemon wheel and a spoon straw.

s.note: Round butter cookies with a thin dark chocolate smile
s.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g icing sugar and mix in 350g flour. Roll out, cut rounds and bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Cool, then pipe a thin line of 50g melted dark chocolate across each as a small smile.

m.note: Grilled lobster tails with garlic lemon butter, buttered potatoes and salad
m.how: Split 4 lobster tails and brush with 80g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and lemon zest. Grill flesh side up for 6 to 8 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with butter. Serve with dressed salad leaves and lemon wedges.

w.note: Roasted pumpkin pie with mixed spice, cooled before slicing
w.how: Roast 800g pumpkin, purée and whisk with 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 200ml cream and 2 tsp mixed spice. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool before slicing.
